description: Create checador2.php with all JS robustness improvements and UX changes, and harden procesar_qr.php with session verification, error hiding, and 2-minute cooldown logic between Entrada and Salida.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/SGA-COBAEV/checador2.php based on the current checador.php. Apply these changes to checador2.php:

SECURITY (checador2.php): Replace the commented-out role verification block with active verification that allows Admin, Prefecto, and Vigilante roles. Use $_SESSION['usuario_rol'] and redirect to login_admin.php if not authorized.
UX (checador2.php): Change the 'Regresar' link href from 'index.php' to 'admin/index.php'.
UX (checador2.php): Add a small link/button in the header that says 'Panel Admin' pointing to 'admin/index.php'.

ROBUSTNESS (checador2.php): Migrate the global 'keypress' event listener to 'keydown'. keypress is deprecated. In keydown, use e.key instead of String.fromCharCode(e.charCode). Accept alphanumeric characters and handle Enter properly.

ROBUSTNESS (checador2.php): In the fetch response handling for enviarMatriculaBackend(), check if response.status === 401. If so, show a message 'Sesion expirada' and redirect to login_admin.php after 2 seconds.
ROBUSTNESS (checador2.php): Add retry logic to cargarBitacoraInicial() - 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). If all retries fail, show a user-friendly message in the bitacora container.

ROBUSTNESS (checador2.php): Add an online/offline connection indicator. Use navigator.onLine + 'online'/'offline' events. Show a small badge in the header (green dot = online, red dot + message = offline). When offline, disable the manual input button and show a warning.
SECURITY (procesar_qr.php): Add session_start() at the top and verify $_SESSION['usuario_autenticado']. If not authenticated, return HTTP 401 JSON error and exit.

SECURITY (procesar_qr.php): Wrap the main try/catch. In the catch(PDOException) block, use error_log() to log the real error and return a generic JSON error message to the client (do not expose $e->getMessage()).

FUNCTIONALITY (procesar_qr.php): Before registering Salida, query the hora of the Entrada record for that student today. Calculate the elapsed time since Entrada. If less than 2 minutes (120 seconds), return a JSON error response with status 'error', icon 'warning', title 'Espera requerida', and a message indicating how many seconds remain before Salida can be registered. Include the remaining seconds in a 'segundos_restantes' field.
acceptance_criteria: checador2.php exists as a separate file from checador.php
checador2.php has active role verification (Admin, Prefecto, Vigilante)
checador2.php uses keydown instead of keypress for HID reader capture
checador2.php handles 401 responses by redirecting to login
checador2.php has retry logic (3 attempts) for cargarBitacoraInicial()
checador2.php has an online/offline visual indicator
checador2.php Regresar link points to admin/index.php
checador2.php has a Panel Admin link in the header
procesar_qr.php verifies session authentication returning 401 if not logged in
procesar_qr.php does not expose PDO error messages to the client
procesar_qr.php enforces 2-minute minimum between Entrada and Salida for same student, returning seconds remaining if violated
php -l checador2.php passes with no syntax errors
php -l procesar_qr.php passes with no syntax errors
findings: All acceptance criteria verified. Both files pass php -l with no syntax errors. checador2.php is a standalone file separate from checador.php with all 10 improvements applied. Post-review fixes applied: (1) Added escapeHtml() utility and applied it to all server-provided data in innerHTML templates to prevent XSS, (2) Added navigator.onLine check in keydown handler to discard HID scans when offline, (3) Unified auth check in obtener_bitacora.php to use strict !== true comparison matching procesar_qr.php.
